name: Eisai
source: After reaching a breaking point with his turbulent home life, academically bright young man Shun Takamine takes an uncharacteristic leap of faith - accepting a place at Inou University, via its prestigious honor society program, Eisai.  Leaving everything he knows behind to start anew across the country, Shun hopes to reinvent his quiet, lonely persona - to make friends, have some fun, and forget his old problems.  However, Shun quickly learns that fresh starts require something he’s never been good at – embracing the unfamiliar.
translation: 在动荡的家庭生活达到崩溃点后，学术上聪明的年轻人高峰俊做出了一次不同寻常的信仰飞跃 - 通过其享有盛誉的荣誉社会计划卫材接受了井能大学的录取。舜抛下他所知道的一切，在全国各地重新开始，他希望重塑自己安静、孤独的形象——去交朋友，找点乐子，忘记他的旧问题。然而，舜很快意识到，新的开始需要一些他从来不擅长的事情——拥抱不熟悉的事物。
